description.fallback: Naruto pursues Gennō to the mountains at the back of town, and hears that he plans to detonate explosive tags there, burying Konoha in a massive rockslide. Before he can do so, Naruto's friends arrive, Hinata having informed them where he was going. They combine their efforts to prevent him from detonating tags, and manage to save the village.

text.fallback: Head out: Multiple Traps! Countdown to Destruction

outro.fallback: Gennō dies after saying that he wanted his son to enjoy another scavenger hunt, and the group realises that while he had initially intended to destroy Konoha, because Naruto reminded him of his son, he made his traps...
Hence, Konoha was actually in no real danger.
